description: The manifest's requirements are floors: the oldest release this integration works with, installed into Home Assistant's shared Python environment.
The org's rangeStrategy "bump" would raise each floor to the newest release, forcing an upgrade there for other integrations too, and #9 asked for a major.
"replace" leaves a >= floor alone and still updates an exact pin. The tested versions are the exact pins in tests/requirements*.txt, which Renovate keeps current.

packageRules.description: tests/requirements-min.txt pins the oldest Home Assistant this integration supports, the minimum hacs.json and the README declare. It moves only when someone moves that minimum, in all three places.
